# Adjudica 1.8.1

Adjudica has a new icon: two halves facing off, in the magenta-to-cyan look that led your own ranking for it.

- **New icon.** The versus mark drawn as a line, magenta running to cyan, on black.
- **Themed icons work.** With themed icons switched on, Android draws the same mark in your wallpaper's colours.
- **Back no longer leaves the app.** At the first screen the back button and gesture do nothing.
- Your lists, items and comparisons are untouched.
